kill_switch.description: true = app disables itself and shows kill_message. Reversible.

defaultValue.value: We're fixing something — back soon. Thanks for your patience! ⚽

kill_message.description: Shown in the blocking window when kill_switch is on.

min_build.description: Builds below this are blocked behind a forced update (opens the Mac App Store). Raise only once that build is live on the App Store.

latest_build.description: Newest published build. Builds below this get a soft 'Update available' banner atop the menu (not blocked). 0 = no banner.

remote_config_fetch_interval_seconds.description: Periodic fetch interval in seconds. Range: 60–86400; default: 300. Startup and foreground fetch immediately. Lower values increase billable fetches.
